Game Overview

In Blast Brigade, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a wild slingshot adventure in Blast Brigade. Strategize and launch your way through enemy fortresses, collecting quirky animals while unleashing chaotic destruction. With vibrant visuals and clever puzzles, experience a cartoonish battle where wit and precision lead to explosive fun.
